title: Oven Crispy Ethiopian Lamb Tibs
description: A salty, crisp one-pot lamb dish with garlic powder and a flambé finish, perfect for a keto-friendly dinner.
instructions: In a bowl, combine lamb cubes with olive oil, garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, coriander, chili flakes, salt, and pepper until fully coated.
Spread the seasoned lamb in a single layer on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Roast in preheated oven for 15 minutes, then flip the lamb and roast for an additional 10 minutes until edges are crisp and golden brown.
While lamb roasts, melt butter in a skillet over medium heat, add white wine, and ignite carefully to flambé, letting the flame die off.
Add the roasted lamb to the skillet, stir to coat with the buttery wine mixture, and cook for 2 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Stir in lemon juice and remove from heat.
Plate the lamb tibs, garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with a side of cauliflower rice or low-carb greens.
